title: Hospitality as Christian Witness
definition: Hospitality as Christian Witness is welcoming others in Christ's name so the grace of God becomes visible through practical love.
summary: Hospitality as Christian Witness uses welcome, meals, space, and friendship to display the Gospel to neighbors and strangers.
christFocus: Jesus Christ welcomed sinners and strangers, and His people reflect His welcome through generous hospitality.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses outwardly on hospitality as witness. It differs from hospitality within the church by emphasizing open doors toward outsiders, neighbors, seekers, and those who may not yet know Christ. Christian hospitality makes the welcome of God visible in ordinary settings.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many people encounter Christian truth before they understand Christian doctrine. A table, conversation, ride, visit, or act of welcome can make the Gospel's kindness tangible. Hospitality also breaks isolation in a lonely culture.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Use your home, schedule, or shared spaces for Gospel-shaped welcome. Invite people who cannot repay you socially. Pray that meals and conversations would become bridges for truth, prayer, and friendship.
